limitations: Both primary reports postdate the transaction; their annotations cannot be historical pre-sign features.
No original victim approval prompt, informed-consent evidence or dated reputation snapshot is available.
The reviews do not establish that every approval to the shared spender was malicious.
Independent-chain review is recorded separately; a one-provider effects oracle is not cross-engine accuracy evidence.
